timeline.question: When does the beta start?
timeline.answer: We run rolling cohorts throughout 2025. New testers are invited every week as we expand capacity.

selection.question: How are testers selected?
selection.answer: We prioritize people who actively log emotions or post on X, and those who can share structured feedback.

cost.question: Does the beta cost anything?
cost.answer: No. All Pro features are free while the beta runs. We will notify you before we launch paid plans.

platform.question: What do I need to use Emotype?
platform.answer: The beta is web-based. A desktop or mobile browser and an email address are all you need.

payment.question: What payment methods are available?
payment.answer: We accept credit card payments through Stripe. Safe and secure payment processing.

changePlan.question: Can I change my plan anytime?
changePlan.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade anytime. Upgrades take effect immediately. For downgrades, Pro plan continues until the end of current billing period, then switches to free plan.

dataRetention.question: What happens to my data when upgrading from free to paid plan?
dataRetention.answer: All your past data is retained and becomes accessible with Pro plan features.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: Monthly subscriptions are non-refundable, but you can cancel your plan anytime. Billing stops from the next renewal date after cancellation.
